checkpoints.note: The zero-delimited witness argv strings are accepted as long options and dispatched into `parse_option()`. The reproduced crash occurs later in `parse_options()`, before any metadata operation or FLAC file I/O runs.

checkpoints.note: First project-side materialization of the witness argv into vulnerability-relevant state. Each abbreviated `--remove-r` enters the `remove-replay-gain` branch and appends five shorthand operations, so the nine witness copies create 45 `Operation` entries in `options->ops.operations` before the import-cuesheet entries are added.

Root cause. `parse_options()` appends a new operation while still holding `op` as a pointer into `options->ops.operations`, but it does not refresh `op` before the next line dereferences it. If the array is full, this call can realloc and invalidate `op`; the fix explicitly re-finds `op` after the append.
